up: Retrieve approved drugs (molecule_dictionary.max_phase >= 4) indicated for depressive disorder. Return the following columns for each matching drug-indication record: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.efo_id, drug_indication.efo_term as indication_label, and drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind. Filter on drug_indication.efo_term or drug_indication.mesh_heading matching 'depressive disorder'.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id, di.efo_term AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM drug_indication di JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON di.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase >= 4 AND (di.efo_term LIKE '%depressive disorder%' OR di.mesh_heading LIKE '%depressive disorder%')
